author: Walrus_Pubes
body:
Arcanic.

It isn't even a question thinking long term right now. Nyx is easily the best t9 raider.  Realmshifter / charmer is easily the fastest raider fresh into t10 with low investment. T9 Apollyan gear and a T9 Ithra blade is all I needed.

Gilgamesh is the meta now, but it takes TONS of work to get it to that point. Significant gear requirements, 240 for Spiked Shield 3, etc. People will try to justify SS1 / 2, but it's just overall worse fresh into T10.

Mage has been in a bad place for years. Heretic was my last T10 class.

Learn from my pain and choose arcanic -> nyx -> rs.
